notes.title: Release Announcement! Beta Testing Ended!
notes.content:
[h1]🍉 Release Announcement! 🎮[/h1]

[h2]Thank You, Beta Testers![/h2]
Firstly, a massive thank you to everyone who participated in our beta testing! Your feedback was invaluable and played a crucial role in shaping the game. 

[h2]Release Date Announcement[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739716/0f05de483cfe447913e22eda970e3f229d004e07.png[/img]
We're thrilled to announce that [b]the game will officially release 11/20 @ 10:00am PST![/b] Get ready to obtain a watermelon!

[h2]Special Shout Outs![/h2]
We want to give a special thanks to three amazing streamers who helped us with valuable feedback and streamed our game:

[list]
[*] PakuPakuru: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pakupakuru]twitch.tv/pakupakuru[/url]
[*] FuzzyFoyz: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/fuzzyfoyz]twitch.tv/fuzzyfoyz[/url]
[*] Staniofficial: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/staniofficial]twitch.tv/staniofficial[/url]
[/list]

Your support means so much to us and we hope to collaborate again in the future!

[h2]Leaderboard Beta Results[/h2]
Here is a final look at the beta leaderboard:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739716/15899247c3e41eb44cc7da8366d7c9f5cd2895db.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates, and once again, thank you for being part of our journey!

[h3]Good luck on your watermelon journey! 🍉[/h3]

notes.title: A big thanks to all of our beta testers!
notes.content:
[b]Thanks to all of our awesome beta testers![/b]

Thank you so much for being a part of the Watermelon Challenge beta test! Your invaluable feedback has played a crucial role in shaping our game, and we're thrilled to share the progress we've made based on your suggestions.

[list]
[*][b]Mouse Controls:[/b] We heard your requests, and now you can effortlessly move and drop fruits using your mouse. This can also be disabled in the options menu if you're feeling old-school. We hope this enhances your gaming experience!
[*][b]Graphical Updates:[/b] Our menus have received a small facelift, with added options on the main title screen. We believe these changes will contribute to a more visually appealing and user-friendly game!
[*][b]Pop Update:[/b] You wanted more pop when combining fruits, and we've made adjustments to bring an extra dose of excitement to those moments. Get ready for an even more satisfying fruit merge!
[*][b]Multiplayer Improvements:[/b] Playing head-to-head with friends is now smoother than ever. We appreciate your feedback on this, and we're continuing to tweak and enhance the multiplayer experience. Plus, we've introduced a new, intense soundtrack specifically for multiplayer sessions!
[/list]

We genuinely couldn't have achieved this level of polish without your dedicated testing. Your enthusiasm and insights have been instrumental in making our first game a success. But, this is just the beginning – there's more in store! Keep the feedback flowing, and aim for that fabled watermelon!

Once again, [b]thank you[/b] for being an essential part of the Watermelon Challenge journey! <3

[center][i]Floofy Feather Studios[/i][/center]
